title: The autopilot runs once inside the container with real secrets, supervised, and passes Stages 0 to 3 on a fresh throwaway sprint
goal: Activation, after the files exist (ST-jmcialmy) and the pins validate (ST-4k63qxd4). The operator's one human step first: he creates the age key (stored in his macOS Keychain) and fills the sops secrets files with his own `sops edit` (the deploy key moved in, the model credential pasted), so no agent session sees a secret. Then a SUPERVISED agent session acting as operator starts the container through the launcher, files a fresh throwaway sprint of two doc-only items, and runs Stages 0 to 3 of kb/_self/autopilot-test.md inside the container with --only on that sprint, as the first host run did; any surprise stops it and is reported. Digest file only for notification. It answers no secrets, push or agents-rule gate beyond the throwaway sprint, never publishes, and writes the per-stage log to kb/_self/reports/ with every defect filed as a bug. The container widening of the guard (ST-gqpjccob) and any unattended run stay separate items.
